about: Fixture map for scripts/check.py: 2048 x 1152 m round the Kachlet dam (project rows 0-1152, columns -3072 to -1024; EPSG:25832 x 824299-826347, y 5389348-5390500): the weir, the power plant and the double lock, whose water overrides (scripts/overrides/water) set the chambers' levels, walls and gates. The lock's lower end lies a few metres from the column -2048 seam of a 2 x 2 cover. All but `name`, `map` and `regions` as in scripts/map.json (the rivers' stretches: the Kachlet levels).
name: Passau Kachlet (fixture)
